details: Bitcoin steadied above $77,000, Ethereum gained traction above $2,100, and XRP rose above $1.35. The broader cryptocurrency market showed subtle signs of recovery as participants awaited the Federal Reserve's April meeting minutes for clues on inflation and policy direction.
title: Crypto Today: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP Rebound Ahead of Fed Minutes

details: Carl Beek and Julian Ma, key contributors to the Ethereum Beacon Chain and censorship resistance efforts, have announced their resignations from the Ethereum Foundation. This follows a trend of several other high-profile departures within the organization this year, raising concerns about the future execution of Ethereum's scalability roadmap.
title: Two More Researchers Resign from Ethereum Foundation Amid Departures Wave

details: Bitcoin's price fell below $77,000, largely influenced by significant spot Bitcoin ETF outflows and mounting macroeconomic pressures, including rising inflation and elevated Treasury yields. Global Bitcoin ETPs experienced their largest weekly outflow of the year, intensifying selling pressure as the asset approached the average cost basis for these ETFs.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $77K Amid Strong ETF Outflows, Macro Headwinds

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity Act has cleared the Senate Banking Committee, moving it closer to a full Senate vote. While the bill aims to provide a clearer regulatory framework for digital assets, analysts suggest the market is exhibiting a "buy the rumor, sell the news" reaction, leading to stagnation or declines in prices post-advancement.
title: CLARITY Act Advances, Market Grapples With 'Sell the News' Effect

details: XRP is showing a cautious rebound, rising above $1.37 after finding short-term support. Institutional interest in XRP spot ETFs has contributed to this recovery, with steady inflows increasing to $1.48 million on Tuesday, marking a four-day bullish streak in cumulative inflows and positively influencing sentiment.
title: XRP Extends Cautious Rebound Amid Steady ETF Inflows
